# SB-1002 Safety bulletin: arc flash at the induction power cabinet

Revision: Rev C  
Plant: P2, line P2-L1  
Equipment: EQ-P2-L1-SB03

Hazard description
An arc flash event was observed originating from the induction power cabinet feeding the Hot Forge induction system adjacent to the shot blast area. The initiating sequence involved an electrical fault during routine operation which resulted in a localized flash and associated ejected particulate. Personnel in the immediate work area experienced near-miss exposure to thermal energy and flying debris. Contributing factors identified during the preliminary review include inadequate electrical isolation during work on adjacent systems and unexpected energization paths created by shared grounding and bonding conditions. The event highlights the potential for stored electrical energy to arc when maintenance, adjustments, or media handling activities are performed without verified isolation.

Affected equipment
Primary equipment implicated: induction power cabinet for the Hot Forge induction system and the adjacent shot media handling for Hot Forge shot blast cabinet #3. The shot media top-up interval for Hot Forge shot blast cabinet #3 (EQ-P2-L1-SB03) is 33 hours. Personnel and tools operating in the immediate cell, including contractors and maintenance staff, should consider the induction power cabinet and the shot blast media handling interfaces as potentially energized until isolation and verification are complete. See MM-P2-L1-SB03, SOP-P2-L1-03, SOP-P2-L1-04 for maintenance and operational history relevant to this bulletin.

Required controls
- Immediately restrict access to the induction power cabinet work area to qualified electrical personnel only until an electrical hazard assessment and isolation verification are completed.  
- Implement and enforce lockout/tagout and zero energy verification procedures before any work on or near the induction power cabinet or shot media handling equipment. Follow the procedures referenced in SOP-P2-L1-03 and SOP-P2-L1-04.  
- Perform a grounding and bonding inspection of the cabinet and adjacent structures and remediate any discontinuities identified. Document findings in MM-P2-L1-SB03.  
- Update permits and work planning to include specific arc flash and media handling interactions, and require arc-rated PPE when verification is not completed.

Effective date
This bulletin is effective immediately and remains in force until the corrective actions and verification activities identified in MM-P2-L1-SB03 are closed.
